messages:
Priya (Infra): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on GPU windows, region sequencing, and the autoscaler fallback behavior. Dropping short answers here.

Ethan (SRE): Will EMEA signups open on the announced date or is it gated by hardware arrival?

Priya (Infra): Signups gated by network tests + initial capacity. Target readiness: 2134720000. If hardware delays, we open a waitlist and notify customers.

Maya (Product): For Dedicated customers who requested EMEA earlier, are we moving them to first-wave pools?

Priya (Infra): Yes, committed Dedicated customers get first-wave placement; ops will reach out to confirm schedules.

Lin (Runtime): Autoscaler note: default now prefers local warm buffer until 0.85 util, then allows cross-region burst if predicted p99 < 180ms. Per-route overrides available.

Ethan (SRE): Can we opt a route out of cross-region bursting during the canary?

Lin (Runtime): Yes 12 there's a per-route toggle in Console "Allow cross-region burst". Default ON for hosted, OFF option for Dedicated.

ops-bot: Procurement alert: PO-13021 placed for mixed A100/H100 EMEA buffer. ETA window 2134680000-2134750000. Rack confirmation needed.

Maya (Product): Action: I'll add a small Console badge that shows "predicted p99 delta" when cross-region burst is possible. Will also update KB.

Priya (Infra): Perf baselines will be published in the model catalog after hardware validations. Lin will run benchmarks within 48h of arrival.

Ethan (SRE): Rollback criteria for the canary?

Priya (Infra): Rollback triggers: sustained p99 increase >25% for 10m, error rate >3x baseline, or throughput regressions >20% on canary routes. Canary aborts automatically.

Maya (Product): Thanks all. If customers ask about latency, point them to the Console badge once live.

Lin (Runtime): I'll post canary logs to #eng and share the dashboard link when it starts.

Priya (Infra): Closing thread later today 12 DM for customer-specific follow-ups. :wave:
